full_judgment: 18. In the instant leave petition, the impugned judgment and order was passed refusing to condon the delay and thereby discharging the Rule (con) on the ground of limitation. It appears from the impugned judgment that it was a judgment of reversal which may found as a merit worthy matter, being thrown out at the very threshold and cause of justice being seriously denied. The substantial justice and methodological considerations when are pitted against each other, cause of sub-stantial justice deserves to be favored for the other side cannot claim to have vested right in injustice being done because of a non-deliberate delay. It must be comprehended that judiciary is respected not on account of its power to legalize injustice on technical grounds but because it is capable of removing injustice and is expected to do so.
